desc:
CAKE MIX: Bake a delicious, moist spice cake dessert with Betty Crocker Delights Cake Mix

QUICK AND EASY: Make a cake by just adding a few simple ingredients as directed and popping in the oven

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Add your own twist to these mixes by using as cupcake mix or trying tested and trusted Betty Crocker recipes

DELICIOUS & SPONGY: Enjoy the sweetness of this versatile cake mix and make it your own; Bake spice cake mix for sweet celebrations and everyday moments

CONTAINS: 13.25 oz
features:
Features

Classic Spice Flavor

Blended with warm spices like cinnamon, nutmeg, and clove for a rich, comforting taste.

Super Moist Texture

Produces a soft, tender crumb that stays moist and fluffy.

Easy to Make

Just add water, oil, and eggs—mix and bake with no hassle.

Versatile Baking Option

Great for baking sheet cakes, layered cakes, cupcakes, or muffins.

Kosher Certified & Box Tops Eligible

Meets certain dietary preferences and supports education programs.

Quality Ingredients

Made with enriched flour, sugar, corn syrup, leavening agents, and a natural spice blend.

Convenient Size

One box yields a standard 13x9 cake or 24 cupcakes.

Allergen Notice

Contains wheat and may contain traces of soy or milk.

Benefits

Delivers Homemade Taste with Ease

Bake a warm, spiced cake without needing scratch ingredients or extensive baking skills.

Perfect for Seasonal Occasions

Ideal for fall desserts, Thanksgiving, or cozy winter treats.

Pairs Well with Frostings & Add-ins

Complements cream cheese, caramel, or vanilla frostings—also pairs well with raisins, apples, or nuts.

Consistent and Reliable Results

Trusted for even baking, great texture, and full-bodied flavor every time.

Kid-Friendly & Beginner Approved

Simple instructions make it perfect for family baking fun or new bakers.

Great Value for Homemade Baking

Affordable mix with bakery-quality results at home.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Corn Syrup, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate, monocalcium phosphate). Contains 2% or less of: Modified Corn Starch, Cinnamon, Corn Starch, Spice, Propylene Glycol Mono and Diesters, Salt, Monoglycerides, Palm Oil, Dicalcium Phosphate, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Xanthan Gum, Cellulose Gum, Color Added.
